product_brief: TPM 2.0 library with initial PQC support for ML-DSA and ML-KEM per spec v1.85.
pqc_capability_description: Initial support for TPM 2.0 Library Specification v1.85. Supports NIST standardized algorithms: ML-DSA (Dilithium) for digital signatures and ML-KEM (Kyber) for key encapsulation. Includes sequence-based signing/verification commands and new types/structures for PQC data handling.
pqc_roadmap_details: Initial support for TPM 2.0 Library Specification v1.85, introducing ML-DSA and ML-KEM.
testing_&_validation_methods: Unit tests available in source code (test_wolfTPM2_MLDSA_*, test_wolfTPM2_MLKEM_*).

product_brief: Trusted Platform Module software implementing TPM 1.2 and TPM 2.0 specifications.
pqc_capability_description: No mention of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms, support, or migration plans in the provided text.
crypto_primitives: RSA, HMAC, AES, Camellia, KDF (KDFe), ECC (Elliptic Curve Cryptography)

deployment_&_migration_complexity: Backwards compatibility issues noted for PCR policies when upgrading from v0.9 to v0.10

product_brief: Software implementation of a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) for virtualized environments.

primary_platforms: Linux (Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu), QEMU, Virtualization environments

product_brief: Post-quantum TPM 2.0 emulator implementing TCG TPM 2.0 Library Specification V1.85 PQC extensions.
pqc_capability_description: Implements TCG TPM 2.0 Library Specification V1.85 PQC extensions. Supports ML-KEM (FIPS 203) and ML-DSA (FIPS 204) via OpenSSL 3.6+ EVP. Includes V1.85 commands (Encapsulate, Decapsulate, SignDigest, VerifyDigestSignature, Sequence commands). Status: Phases 1-5.1 Complete. V1.85 RC4 compliance suite: 104 passed, 0 failed. Cross-implementation conformance with wolfTPM v4.0.0.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM (512, 768, 1024), ML-DSA (44, 65, 87), HashML-DSA, RSA, ECC, symmetric
fips_validated: No (References FIPS 203 and FIPS 204 standards for algorithms, but does not state FIPS 140 validation status for the module itself)
pqc_roadmap_details: Phases 1-5.1 are Complete. Phase 5.x (WASM Integration npm package, TypeScript wrapper) is Not started.
testing_&_validation_methods: NIST ACVP KATs (75 ML-DSA keyGen KATs), TCG V1.85 RC4 compliance suite (104 checks), Cross-implementation runtime cross-check vs wolfTPM v4.0.0 (29 passed), OpenSSL EVP round-trips.
